+title: 'Remove the compaction marker: .compact, CompactionMarker and CompactionMarkerView'
+---
+## What
+ACP alpha.3 has no compaction signal. The owner decided to remove the compaction marker now (update.md §3 D5, §6).
+
+Note: the built client model (FoundationModelsACPClient `a65af8a`) has a `CompactionEntry` for an unstable ACP compaction update. The task "Show CompactionEntry and SessionNotice rows" adds a view for it later. Do not keep the old view for it: the old view binds to the kit model.
+
+- [ ] Delete `Sources/AgentViewKit/Model/CompactionMarker.swift` and `Sources/AgentViewKit/Items/CompactionMarkerView.swift`.
+- [ ] Remove `.compact` from `ThreadItem`, `ThreadChange`, `ItemPatch` and `AgentThread`. Remove the compaction cases from `ItemRow.swift`, `ItemViewOverrides.swift`, `ErrorView.swift`, `ErrorActions.swift`, and the compaction tokens from `AgentTheme.swift`.
+- [ ] Delete `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Model/CompactionChangeTests.swift` and `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Items/CompactionMarkerViewHostedTests.swift`. Change `AgentThreadApplyTests`, `ThreadItemTests`, `ErrorViewHostedTests` and `AgentThemeTests`. Change `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Theme/DefaultTokens.json` if it lists the tokens.
+- [ ] Add `CompactionMarker` and `CompactionMarkerView` to `Tests/PackageStructureTests/RemovedVocabularyTests.swift`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] No source uses `CompactionMarker` or the `.compact` case.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `RemovedVocabularyTests` fails before the removal and passes after it.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
